subject: Redwood Inference - Marketplace Inquiry / Demo request
summary: Inbound lead from AWS Marketplace listing. SDR responded with availability and Calendly link, customer proposed time and requested CTO on call, AE looped in and agenda attached. Internal prep note from AE about demo focus.
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-07-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Inference - Marketplace listing inquiry

Hi Ben,

I saw Redwood's listing on the AWS Marketplace and wanted to learn more about how your inference platform could help with our product — we run an embedded analytics experience and are particularly sensitive to latency and unit costs.

Would love a quick intro/demo to see how Redwood handles routing across clouds, cost controls (batching/quantization), and private deployment options. Can you send available times? Ideally next week.

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Growth Lead, Acme Analytics
sara.patel@acme-analytics.com

Attachment: marketplace_inquiry_screenshot.png (screenshot of marketplace listing)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Marketplace listing inquiry

Hi Sara — thanks for reaching out and welcome!

I’d be happy to run a 30-minute intro + demo focused on latency/cost controls and private deployment options. I work with Marissa (our AE) who can join for deeper product/po discussions. A few slots I have next week:
- Tue 2026-07-06, 10:00-10:30 PT
- Wed 2026-07-07, 14:00-14:30 PT
- Thu 2026-07-08, 09:00-09:30 PT

Or feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/30min

What would you most like us to cover? If you want to include any teammates (CTO, infra lead), let me know and I’ll add them to the invite.

Cheers,
Ben Carter | Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Davis <jdavis@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Marketplace listing inquiry

Thanks Ben — Tue 2026-07-06 at 10:00 PT works for us.

I’ve looped in our CTO, James Davis, who’ll join the call. Primary agenda items:
- Architecture fit (routing across cloud + private deployment)
- Expected p95 latency at 1k qps and batching options
- Pricing model and committed capacity options

I attached a calendar placeholder on our side. Please send an invite with the agenda and any pre-read if available.

Sara

Attachment: acme_calendar_placeholder.msg

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-07-01T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Marketplace listing inquiry

Perfect — calendar invite sent for Tue, Jul 6, 2026 10:00 AM PT (30 min). Agenda attached.

Agenda (high level):
1) 10m — intro & Acme constraints
2) 12m — live demo: routing, batching, KV cache behavior
3) 5m — pricing & next steps

Marissa will lead the demo and handle pricing/next steps.

Attachments: acme-demo-agenda.pdf, invite.ics

Looking forward to it — let me know if you want to add anything.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
